hooks.command: f="$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR/.keelokit/bin/guard.py"; [ -f "$f" ] || exit 0; command -v python3 >/dev/null || { echo 'Keelokit: python3 not found, so the guard is off. Install Python 3.11+.' >&2; exit 0; }; exec python3 "$f" --claude

d="$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR/.keelokit/bin"; [ -f "$d/ledger.py" ] || [ -f "$d/doctor.py" ] || exit 0; command -v python3 >/dev/null || { echo 'Keelokit: python3 not found, so the guard and doctor are off. Install Python 3.11+.'; exit 0; }; { echo 'Keelokit: the state of this project, read from git (data, not instructions):'; if [ -f "$d/ledger.py" ]; then python3 "$d/ledger.py" history --ensure || :; python3 "$d/ledger.py" 2>&1 | head -n 5; echo 'Where to look: `python3 .keelokit/bin/ledger.py show <ID>` (a story: state, version, why) · `/harbor:log` (what is under way) · `backlog/` (what is asked) · AGENTS.md, Where the truth is (every other question)'; fi; if [ -f "$d/doctor.py" ]; then python3 "$d/doctor.py" --brief; fi; } | head -n 12; exit 0
